items.title: AI is dramatically accelerating AI research

items.titleZh: AI 正在大幅加速 AI 研究

items.title: Tesla to wind down Cybertruck production
items.summary: Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at its Texas gigafactory around mid-2027, CEO Elon Musk said on Friday, after years of persistently weak sales for a futuristic model once touted as a rival to legacy pickup tru…
items.titleZh: 特斯拉将逐步停止 Cybertruck 生产
items.summaryZh: 特斯拉首席执行官埃隆·马斯克周五表示，公司将在 2027 年年中左右逐步停止得州超级工厂的 Cybertruck 生产。此前，这款曾被宣传为传统皮卡竞争对手的未来感车型，多年来销量持续低迷。

items.title: A Jev that can ask Opus for help gives Opus accuracy at 4x lower cost
items.summary: We tested Jev and GPT-6 Luna as judges for identity resolution. A hybrid of Jev and Claude Opus matched frontier accuracy at over 4x lower cost.
items.titleZh: 能向 Opus 求助的 Jev，准确率相当于 Opus，成本低 4 倍
items.summaryZh: 我们测试了 Jev 和 GPT-6 Luna 在身份解析任务中担任评审的表现。Jev 与 Claude Opus 的混合方案以低逾 4 倍的成本，达到了前沿模型的准确率。

items.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
items.summary: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash brings native 15-second video generation and editing, stronger consistency, and 30% lower pricing.
items.summaryZh: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 支持原生生成和编辑最长 15 秒的视频，提升了内容一致性，价格也降低了 30%。

items.title: Firecracker VM Escape: PwnEscape Part 2
items.summary: A malicious guest crossed Firecracker's microVM boundary, resolved the live VMM from inside the VM, and took control of a root-run host process—turning a Linux networking flaw into a guest-to-host code-execution primitiv…
items.titleZh: Firecracker 虚拟机逃逸：PwnEscape 第二部分
items.summaryZh: 恶意来宾系统突破了 Firecracker 微型虚拟机的边界，在虚拟机内部定位到正在运行的虚拟机监控器，并控制了一个以 root 权限运行的宿主机进程——将 Linux 网络漏洞转化为从来宾到宿主机的代码执行漏洞。

items.title: Sodium-ion batteries approach cost parity with LFP
items.summary: Sodium-ion batteries are approaching cell-level cost parity with LFP technology, with supply agreements exceeding 70 GWh worldwide. Despite higher upfront costs, they could offer a 21% lower total cost of ownership over…
items.titleZh: 钠离子电池成本接近与磷酸铁锂电池持平
items.summaryZh: 钠离子电池的电芯成本正接近磷酸铁锂（LFP）技术，全球供应协议总量已超过 70 GWh。尽管前期成本较高，但其总拥有成本可能低 21%。

items.title: US FAA says it will phase out floppy disks from air traffic control by 2028
items.titleZh: 美国联邦航空管理局称，将在 2028 年前逐步淘汰空中交通管制系统中的软盘

items.title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
items.summary: The deal highlights the challenges of developing massive AI data centers.
items.titleZh: Crusoe 将陷入困境的怀俄明州数据中心项目出售给 Google
items.summaryZh: 这笔交易凸显了建设大型 AI 数据中心面临的挑战。

items.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
items.summary: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion as part of a funding round that hasn't closed yet but is expected to in the coming weeks.
items.titleZh: 据报道，OpenAI 以 1.25 万亿美元估值再融资 110 亿美元
items.summaryZh: 据报道，OpenAI 在一轮尚未完成、预计将在未来几周内结束的融资中再筹集了 110 亿美元。

items.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
items.summary: Security researchers found hundreds of servers hosting the penetration testing tool Artex exposed to the internet, allowing anyone access to the hacking tool.
items.titleZh: 数百个 Artex AI 黑客工具被发现暴露在公网上
items.summaryZh: 安全研究人员发现，数百台托管渗透测试工具 Artex 的服务器暴露在互联网上，任何人都能访问该黑客工具。

items.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
items.summary: Meta's Muse agents continue to get new features and integrations. Spaces promises to be a new way to interact with the AI helpers.
items.titleZh: Meta 推出 Spaces，为用户提供与 Muse 智能体协作的新方式
items.summaryZh: Meta 的 Muse 智能体不断获得新功能和集成。Spaces 将提供一种与这些 AI 助手互动的新方式。

items.title: After the midterms, is the AI industry in for a rough two years?
items.summary: Democrats’ historic victories in this week’s U.S. midterm elections could also transform the tech industry. The public voted on 41 data center-related ballot measures on Tuesday — in all but one, the majority voted to im…
items.titleZh: 美国中期选举后，AI 行业是否将迎来艰难的两年？
items.summaryZh: 民主党在本周美国中期选举中取得历史性胜利，也可能改变科技行业。周二，公众就 41 项与数据中心相关的投票议案作出表决，其中除一项外，其余议案均获多数支持……

items.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
items.summary: AI usage keeps climbing, but spending has stalled. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among the biggest spenders could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth.
items.titleZh: Ramp 数据显示 AI 支出停滞，Anthropic 即将 IPO
items.summaryZh: AI 使用量持续攀升，但支出已经停滞。最大用户削减价格并加强成本控制，可能会挑战投资者对 AI 高速增长的预期。

items.title: After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop
items.summary: Amazon said that the feature will roll out to millions of users in coming weeks.
items.titleZh: 封锁 Muse 后，亚马逊如今允许用户通过短信向 Alexa 求助购物
items.summaryZh: 亚马逊表示，这项功能将在未来几周内向数百万用户推出。

items.title: Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo
items.summary: Despite its small size, Underdog's new model can generate both speech and music.
items.titleZh: Underdog 在最新演示中展示 32 MB 语音模型
items.summaryZh: 尽管体积小巧，Underdog 的新模型既能生成语音，也能生成音乐。
